abstract: Audits GDP certifications and international customs pre-clearance status
system_message:
You are the Regulatory compliance and customs lead (CMP), responsible for auditing Good Distribution Practice (GDP) depot certifications and international customs pre-clearance status across candidate cross-docking hubs and gateway brokers, as well as tracking operational personnel compliance training records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Personnel GDP training（TRAIN）
information_points.content:
CMP-TRAIN-TOG：For Vanguard Life Science Cold-Chain Solution, the certified handler refresher completion rate among active warehouse and transport staff is 85%.
CMP-TRAIN-EID：For AeroCold Global Pharma Transit Alliance, the verified annual GDP refresher completion rate for active warehouse and transport handlers is 100%.
CMP-TRAIN-RBQ：For CryoTrans Intermodal Biologics Consortium, the certified handler refresher completion rate across active operational handlers stands at 95%.

information_points.title: Audits GDP certifications and international customs pre-clearance status（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
CMP-AUDIT-UQJ：For AeroCold Global Pharma Transit Alliance, all primary cross-docking and warehouse operating hubs hold valid Good Distribution Practice certification, and the candidate possesses authorized expedited customs pre-clearance across key international transit lanes.
CMP-AUDIT-5ZX：For Vanguard Life Science Cold-Chain Solution, all primary cross-docking and warehouse facilities hold valid Good Distribution Practice certification, and expedited customs pre-clearance is authorized across its key international transit lanes.
CMP-AUDIT-U3I：For CryoTrans Intermodal Biologics Consortium, the primary operating hubs do not hold valid Good Distribution Practice certification, though the candidate does possess authorized expedited customs pre-clearance across key international transit lanes.
